:::{#def-product-sigma-algebra}
#### Product $\sigma$-algebra

Let $(S, \mathscr{S})$ and $(T, \mathscr{T})$ be [measurable spaces](#def-measure-space).
A **measurable rectangle** is a [Cartesian product](sets-functions.qmd#def-cartesian-product)
$A \times B$ with $A \in \mathscr{S}$ and $B \in \mathscr{T}$.
The **product $\sigma$-algebra** $\mathscr{S} \otimes \mathscr{T}$
is the $\sigma$-algebra on $S \times T$
[generated by](#def-generated-sigma-algebra) the measurable rectangles.

:::
